test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: What is the passage based upon?

options.text: Political leaders and their opportunism in using court decisions for their own pastime
The bureaucracy in India and the egoism of the leaders in the administration
Existing border dispute between Karnataka and Maharashtra fuelled often by politicians, not common men
Linguistic narrowmindedness of the common men of the two states Karnataka and Maharashtra

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage focuses on the long-standing boundary dispute between Karnataka and Maharashtra over Belgavi.
 
• It discusses how political actions and rhetoric have fuelled the dispute, causing disruptions for the common people in the region.
 
• The passage highlights the role of politicians in escalating tensions, while pointing out that many inhabitants of border areas speak both languages and coexist peacefully.
 
• It emphasizes the need for active national interstate councils to manage such disputes and maintain harmony.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3: Existing border dispute between Karnataka and Maharashtra fuelled often by politicians, not common men**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** The passage does not focus on court decisions or political leaders using them for pastime.
 
• **Option 2:** The passage does not discuss the bureaucracy in India or egotism of leaders in administration.
 
• **Option 4:** The passage notes that many common people in the disputed area speak both languages and doesn't attribute the issue to linguistic narrowmindedness of common men.
